snippet.title: Mica King - Announcement Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Introducing Mica King, a new top-down 3D action adventure from LAB132, revealed for the first time during the GamingUp Showcase 2026.

Journey to a once-great magical kingdom as an adventurer with extraordinary abilities. Uncover the mysterious power of Mica and face the dark forces behind the bitter downfall of the king.

Create your own character and master different combat styles ranging from melee and ranged attacks to arcane abilities. Explore a handcrafted 3D world, solve riddles, overcome obstacles and craft upgrades for your weapons and gear as you unlock new abilities and venture into new areas.

Mica King is coming to PC and consoles in 2027.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320450/Mica_King/
